newsitem.title: JAPAN: Medium earthquake shakes Japan near Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Medium earthquake shakes Japan near Tokyo.

text.p: An earthquake shook Japan's main island of Honshu north of Tokyo early on Thursday morning but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, a Meteorological Agency spokesman said.
The spokesman told reporters the earthquake measured four on the Japanese scale -- a medium size tremor -- in the coastal prefectures of Fukushima and Tochigi about 160 km (100 miles) north of Tokyo.
He said there was no danger of tidal waves from the tremor at about 5.20 a.m.(2020 GMT) in an area regularly shaken by small quakes.
